summary: The Array.from implementation in from.rs follows the pinned spec steps 1 to 14 in order. The mapper IsCallable check comes before GetMethod. The iterator path (5.a to 5.e) has the IsConstructor/Construct vs ArrayCreate(0) choice, GetIteratorFromMethod, the 2^53-1 check with IteratorClose, IteratorStepValue, mapping with IfAbruptCloseIterator, and CreateDataPropertyOrThrow with IfAbruptCloseIterator. The array-like path (7 to 14) uses ToObject, LengthOfArrayLike, Construct or ArrayCreate(len), the Get/Call/CreateDataPropertyOrThrow loop, and the final Set of "length". Each step is kept as a comment above its code. No special-casing, no made-up values, no swallowed errors. The remaining four test262 failures come from unimplemented String and ArrayBuffer built-ins, which throw the engine's not-implemented error as they should. The only extra change is the import of array_create and renaming the unused new_target parameter to _new_target, both needed for this file.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. The diff is ready to merge as far as this review can tell. The 4 remaining test262 failures depend on String.prototype[Symbol.iterator] and ArrayBuffer, which belong to other tickets.
